steps.say: I run a small studio. I want to see what this mate would tell my customers.

problem.title: On load the chat first said 'Hi, I'm your mate' with the Busymate logo, then switched to the studio
problem.steps: Open the try page in a fresh browser
problem.expected: The studio's name and logo from the first frame (or a neutral skeleton)
problem.actual: A generic mate greeting and logo for about 0.5 s (frames 00:00.46–00:01.11), then the studio's
problem.area: chat iframe first render before the workspace branding arrives
problem.ux: Render a skeleton until branding is known, or pass the branding in the iframe URL
problem.perf: Inline the branding in the iframe's HTML so no second render is needed

problem.title: Behind the scenes the page fetched the same suggestions 4 times and the same scan 4 times
problem.steps: Open the try page; watch the network lane
problem.actual: 4 identical GET /api/quickstart/suggest (one aborted), 4 identical GET /api/quickstart/scan in 0.45 s, 2 event streams to /api/quickstart/deep/watch (one aborted)
problem.area: try page data hooks (effect runs twice / several components fetch the same thing)
problem.ux: None visible directly; on first visit the suggested questions took about 7 s to appear
problem.perf: Share one request per resource (a cache or request dedupe), open one stream

steps.keys: Do you do kitchen renovations? What does a consult cost?

problem.title: Every visit logs a red 404 in the console: the bot check answers 404 when there is nothing to check
problem.steps: Open the try page with DevTools console open
problem.expected: A 200/204 'no challenge' answer, a clean console
problem.actual: GET /api/quickstart/bot-challenge → 404 and 'Failed to load resource' in the console
problem.ux: None for visitors; it hides real errors from developers and monitoring
problem.perf: Return 204 or skip the call when no challenge is configured
